text: 1349 repairs a missing, non-integer or future persisted lastUpdate by resetting it to zero and adds initialization assertions for seeds and interaction IDs. This is a useful dated persistence-validation pattern. Accepted updater scheduling uses cache expiration and returns loadFromCache/hasCache; the captured accepted InAppNotifications module has no lastUpdate field. Do not apply the 2024 timestamp guard as a description of current refresh scheduling. This is static source and test-code inspection.
